court: Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit

issues.label: Standard of review of adverse credibility
issues.why: Court must apply substantial evidence/clear error deference to the credibility finding.

issues.label: Basis for adverse credibility determination
issues.why: Whether cited discrepancies in positions and dates support an adverse credibility finding under the totality of circumstances.

issues.label: Materiality of inconsistencies under REAL ID
issues.why: Whether inconsistencies need be material and whether trivial date/title discrepancies suffice to undermine credibility.

issues.label: Failure to give opportunity to explain
issues.why: Whether the IJ confronted Eqbal with perceived discrepancies and allowed explanation before discrediting him.

issues.label: Pro se litigant considerations
issues.why: Whether Eqbal's unrepresented status affected the fairness of the credibility and evidentiary assessment.

issues.label: Corroboration requirement analysis
issues.why: Whether the IJ properly required corroboration and gave notice of what evidence was needed and its availability.

issues.label: Weight of non-testimonial evidence
issues.why: Whether independent documentary evidence should have been evaluated despite the adverse credibility finding.

issues.label: Independent eligibility from documentary record
issues.why: Whether the record independently establishes eligibility even absent credible testimony.

issues.label: Asylum past persecution showing
issues.why: Whether the 1997-98 arrest, torture, and back injury establish past persecution.

issues.label: Well-founded fear of future persecution
issues.why: Whether Taliban arrest warrants and searches establish objective and subjective fear.

issues.label: Protected ground - political opinion/imputed
issues.why: Whether his government service constitutes imputed political opinion nexus.

issues.label: Protected ground - Tajik ethnicity
issues.why: Whether persecution on account of his ethnic group is established.

issues.label: Nexus between harm and protected ground
issues.why: Whether feared harm is on account of a protected ground rather than mere criminal/retributive motive.

issues.label: Membership in particular social group
issues.why: Whether former government security personnel constitutes a cognizable PSG.

issues.label: Internal relocation feasibility
issues.why: Whether Eqbal could safely relocate within Afghanistan given nationwide Taliban control.

issues.label: Country conditions evidence for Afghanistan
issues.why: Whether the IJ considered current conditions showing Taliban targeting of former officials.

issues.label: Withholding of removal clear-probability standard
issues.why: Whether Eqbal shows more-likely-than-not persecution for withholding eligibility.

issues.label: CAT torture likelihood
issues.why: Whether it is more likely than not Eqbal would be tortured if returned.

issues.label: CAT government acquiescence/state action
issues.why: Whether the Taliban as de facto government satisfies CAT's public-official requirement.

issues.label: CAT independent of credibility
issues.why: Whether CAT claim must be assessed on all record evidence apart from credibility.

issues.label: Bars to asylum/withholding
issues.why: Whether persecutor bar or material support/terrorism bars apply given his armed security roles.

issues.label: Removability finding
issues.why: Whether Eqbal is properly removable for lacking valid entry documents.

issues.label: BIA independent reasoning adequacy
issues.why: Whether the BIA's affirmance provides sufficient reasoning for meaningful review.

issues.label: One-year asylum filing deadline
issues.why: Whether Eqbal timely filed asylum within one year of entry.

issues.label: Due process at hearing
issues.why: Whether the proceeding afforded a full and fair opportunity to present the claim.
